realToolNegativeSubcases: TLS-D4-27 includes every full/schema/roles tool against non-TLS, wrong-CA and wrong-hostname endpoints; report all subcases, not one opaque PASS.
ownedEnvironment: Existing cached pinned PG17 image, network none, no host ports, tmpfs data. TLS loopback listener inside owned container; ephemeral self-signed test CA/cert generated with existing OpenSSL, never production CA/credentials. Existing test files contain setup; repository fixtures unchanged. No package install.
productionTransportTests: Finite injected mock authorization/source/target controls for production branch; no real production credential path read. Real client TLS cases use explicitly owned container-only target identity, unreachable from production CLI.
expectedChangesAllowed: CAPTURE_25 must stop equating backend false with client TLS failure; instead assert missing/invalid client proof rejects and valid risk/client proof permits false.
Production authorization helpers/schema and capture/backup receipt assertions move forward explicitly; preserve historical evidence and business/migration expected results.
skipPolicy: Any safety-critical skip/failure blocks v4 proposal.
staticChecks: Python syntax without production imports side effects
approval v3 rejection and v4 hash binding
v4Generation: Only after all validation passes, generate new approved=false/executionAuthorized=false v4 proposal binding new source/test/package/risk hashes; do not execute capture.
